note: Curated by hand from the rustinfer tree (code, Cargo.toml, docs/adr, docs/api, docs/planning, the SRS clause texts) at commit b21ae62. Each candidate is a standard the code or the plan already depends on that SRS-RI-v0.1 section 1.4 does not reference. It becomes tracked only after an SRS amendment adds a 1.4 row and a requirement cites it. Versions marked 'to confirm' are suggestions, not decisions. 'aliases' are the regular expressions gen_standards.py uses to report where the SRS text already names the standard.

candidates.title: IEEE Std 754-2019, IEEE Standard for Floating-Point Arithmetic
candidates.why: fp16 (binary16) and fp32 (binary32) semantics, round-to-nearest-even and NaN/Inf rules of the CPU reference conversions; bf16 is binary32 with the low 16 mantissa bits dropped and should be defined against it.

candidates.title: OCP 8-bit Floating Point Specification (OFP8)
candidates.why: The SRS names 'OCP e4m3' (RI-MIR-003) and fp8 KV storage without a reference; the kernel compiler also maps E5M2, which the SRS does not list.

candidates.title: AMD Instinct MI300 (CDNA3) Instruction Set Architecture Reference Guide: FP8 E4M3 FNUZ (with LLVM APFloat Float8E4M3FNUZ as the executable definition)
candidates.why: gfx942 fp8 is the FNUZ variant (bias 8, max 240, the negative-zero pattern is the only NaN); the SRS names 'FNUZ e4m3' with no definition.
evidence: crates/rustinfer-target/src/numeric.rs:20 (E4M3FNUZ NaN is the negative-zero pattern)

candidates.title: safetensors file format (Hugging Face)
candidates.version: release tag to pin at amendment, to confirm
candidates.why: The checkpoint shard layout (8-byte little-endian header length, JSON header of dtype/shape/data_offsets, tiling rule) and its dtype names (F8_E4M3, BF16, ...) are parsed by the one shared header reader.
evidence: crates/rustinfer-artifact/src/safetensors.rs:1 (the one header reader; layout and tiling rule)

candidates.title: Hugging Face Transformers model configuration (config.json, generation_config.json)
candidates.version: Transformers release to pin, to confirm
candidates.why: model_type, the architecture fields and quantization_config are read from config.json; their names and meanings are Transformers conventions.
evidence: crates/rustinfer-frontend/src/config.rs:1 (config.json bounded parse and model_type registry)

candidates.title: Hugging Face Tokenizers serialization (tokenizer.json) and chat templates
candidates.version: tokenizers release to pin, to confirm
candidates.why: RI-SRV-003 requires a tokenizer compatible with HF tokenizer.json; RI-CLI-006 adds text prompts through the tokenizer in R2.
evidence: docs/SRS-RI-v0.1.md:292 (tokenizer files in the HF checkpoint contract)

candidates.title: Hugging Face PEFT LoRA adapter layout (adapter_config.json plus safetensors)
candidates.version: PEFT release to pin, to confirm
candidates.why: Section 3.1.3 names the PEFT layout as the LoRA adapter input contract; no requirement cites a version.

candidates.title: LLVM User Guide for AMDGPU Backend (AMDGPUUsage): ELF code objects and the AMDHSA ABI
candidates.version: the code object version LLVM 23 emits by default (V5 or V6), to confirm and record
candidates.why: The artifact carries AMD HSA code objects that are loaded with the HIP module loader and checked (LDS, registers) against the device; their format and kernel descriptor are this document.
evidence: crates/rustinfer-core/src/kernel.rs:14 (an AMD HSA code object, RI-ROC-004)

candidates.title: HIP Runtime API Reference (ROCm)
candidates.why: Section 2.4 pins ROCm 7.0 to 7.2 and 3.1.3 lists the HIP runtime as an interface (memory, streams, events, modules, launches, graphs) but 1.4 has no row.

candidates.title: ROCm Communication Collectives Library (RCCL) API (NCCL-compatible)
candidates.why: All-reduce, all-gather, reduce-scatter and all-to-all go through RCCL (3.1.3); RI-SEC-001 allows loading it.
evidence: docs/adr/ADR-005-three-representations-and-own-kernel-compiler.md:54 (only HIP runtime and RCCL are loaded)

candidates.title: LLVM (AMDGPU, RISC-V and SPIR-V back ends; lld as a library)
candidates.why: ADR-007 pins LLVM major 23; section 1.4 has only the MLIR row, and that row still says LLVM 22. The amendment should add LLVM and correct the MLIR row's version to 23.

candidates.title: Khronos SPIR-V Specification (unified)
candidates.why: The spirv-vulkan target emits SPIR-V modules through MLIR's spirv dialect (R1 stub, R2 lowering).

candidates.title: Khronos Vulkan API Specification
candidates.version: not stated anywhere in the tree; set with the spirv-vulkan lowering
candidates.why: Section 3.1.2 names Vulkan as the runtime of SPIR-V devices (Imagination GPU on SpacemiT K3).

candidates.title: RISC-V "V" Vector Extension
candidates.why: RI-RV-004 already says 'SHALL target RVV 1.0' in its clause; section 1.4 has no row for it.

candidates.title: FIPS PUB 180-4, Secure Hash Standard (SHA-256)
candidates.why: The artifact content hash, the per-tensor digests and the checkpoint identity are SHA-256.

candidates.title: RFC 8259, The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format
candidates.why: Every small artifact section, the Model IR document, config.json and the safetensors header are JSON; the canonical form (sorted keys, compact, exact integers) is a profile of it and should say so.

candidates.title: ISO 8601-1:2019, Date and time representations (profile: RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds)
candidates.why: RI-CLI-011 requires ISO-8601 timestamps in every log line and the metadata timestamp is checked as ISO-8601 UTC; the clause names the standard without a 1.4 row.

candidates.title: Prometheus text-based exposition format
candidates.why: Section 3.1.3 lists metrics out as Prometheus text exposition; RI-SRV-002 exposes /prometheus/metrics and RI-OBS-001 defines the metric names.

candidates.title: OpenAI API reference: Chat Completions, Completions and Models (openai-openapi)
candidates.version: openai-openapi at a dated commit, to confirm
candidates.why: RI-SRV-001 requires OpenAI-compatible shapes for /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions and /v1/models; 'compatible' needs a pinned schema.

candidates.title: RFC 9110 HTTP Semantics and RFC 9112 HTTP/1.1
candidates.why: Section 3.1.4 fixes HTTP/1.1; RI-SRV-005 assigns status codes 400, 429 and 503.

candidates.title: WHATWG HTML Living Standard, Server-sent events
candidates.version: living standard; pin a snapshot date
candidates.why: Streaming responses use SSE (3.1.1, 3.1.4, RI-SRV-001).

rejected.title: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0
rejected.reason: Not used: the artifact and Model IR versions are integers (ARTIFACT_FORMAT_VERSION, MODEL_IR_FORMAT_VERSION in crates/rustinfer-core/src/config/constants.rs:25,71) and docs/api/CHANGELOG.md:6 uses vMAJOR.MINOR with BREAKING marks; the crate version is Cargo's and publish = false.

rejected.title: NVIDIA NCCL API
rejected.reason: No NVIDIA target; RCCL's NCCL-compatible API is the dependency and is listed as RCCL.

rejected.title: Compute Express Link specification
rejected.reason: The planner only names CXL as a memory tier and link kind (crates/rustinfer-planner/src/topology.rs:90, crates/rustinfer-mir/src/tensor.rs:19); discovery (RI-PLN-002, R2) reads the OS, and no CXL protocol or register interface is implemented or planned.

rejected.title: InfiniBand/RoCE verbs (rdma-core)
rejected.reason: Only planning prose (docs/planning/datacenter-device-inventory.md:46) and RI-PLN-006 (R4) mention RDMA; no interface is chosen. Revisit with the R4 DPU work.

rejected.title: OpenTelemetry (OTLP)
rejected.reason: No requirement; docs/observability.md:12 says no OTLP export before multi-node (R4).

rejected.title: UALink 1.0/2.0 and Ultra Ethernet
rejected.reason: Device inventory only (docs/planning/datacenter-device-inventory.md:65,77); reached through RCCL, no rustinfer interface; R4.

rejected.title: JSON Canonicalization Scheme
rejected.reason: The canonical JSON of crates/rustinfer-artifact/src/json.rs:1 is rustinfer's own (sorted keys, compact, exact integers), not JCS; only needed if a third party must reproduce section hashes.
